domain.name: 目标检测：准确率与推理速度

taxonomy_tree.name: method
taxonomy_tree.description: Classify the detector being measured, not the paper's cited baselines. Fast/Faster R-CNN and SPPnet are region_based; YOLO is dense_regression; SSD/MultiBox are multibox. Use unknown if unsupported.

taxonomy_tree.name: scenario
taxonomy_tree.description: Dataset and evaluation split. Never merge different VOC years or COCO splits. Speed-only statements without a named benchmark use unknown.

core_metrics.name: voc_map50
core_metrics.description: Absolute overall detection mAP at IoU 0.5 on a named PASCAL VOC test split. Not per-class AP, recall, relative improvement or COCO averaged AP. Record VOC year and evaluation protocol; unknown when the text does not specify the AP integration convention.

core_metrics.name: coco_ap
core_metrics.description: Absolute COCO detection AP averaged over IoU 0.50:0.05:0.95. Never treat AP50, AP75, AP_small or VOC mAP as this metric.

core_metrics.name: coco_ap_small
core_metrics.description: Absolute COCO AP for small objects under the standard COCO small-area definition and averaged IoU protocol. A qualitative claim about small objects is not a measurement.

core_metrics.name: coco_ap75
core_metrics.description: Absolute COCO AP at IoU 0.75, not VOC AP50 or COCO averaged AP.

core_metrics.name: inference_fps
core_metrics.description: Explicitly reported inference frames per second for the evaluated detector. Preserve hardware, batch size, input resolution, model variant and timing_scope. Do not calculate FPS from latency or from a dataset-total runtime.

core_metrics.name: inference_latency
core_metrics.description: Explicitly reported per-image detector inference time, including detector_only_excludes_proposals when stated. Distinguish this from end_to_end inference. Exclude individual-layer/proposal-only times, training time, speedup ratios and total time for a whole test set. Return the original value/unit; the application converts seconds to milliseconds explicitly.

extraction_instructions: Task scope: compare the paper authors own single-detector aggregate accuracy and inference speed. Include measured author ablations with a distinct model_variant. Exclude cited baseline/comparison rows and other papers results; result_role must be primary or ablation. Exclude ensemble/fusion rows from this single-detector collection.

Use context_conditions keys exactly as listed. method and scenario use the canonical taxonomy values. detector_family identifies Fast R-CNN, Faster R-CNN, YOLO, SSD, etc. Never use a backbone name as a detector family.

Copy the original reported numeric value and unit without calculating conversions or reciprocals. Absolute percent accuracy is distinct from percentage-point improvements and relative gains; never put a gain into voc_map50 or coco_ap.

Separate VOC 2007, VOC 2010 and VOC 2012; preserve training_data such as VOC07 vs VOC07+12. Do not infer the VOC integration convention, test resolution, batch size or speed dataset from model memory.

For accuracy rows use timing_scope=not_applicable. For speed use end_to_end, detector_only_excludes_proposals or unknown. GPU/hardware and timing scope must come from supporting evidence, not assumptions. Faster R-CNN proposal/layer timings are not total detector latency.

A table value is usable only with its row label and column header. Cite every source chunk needed for value, model, dataset and units. Preserve source_table and concise reasoning. Do not substitute an abstract rounded value for a precise table result, or combine values from different versions of a paper.

Missing or ambiguous context must be unknown; retain the measurement for review rather than inventing missing conditions. Do not transfer hardware, training split or backbone across unrelated experiments.

Return at most 6 distinct measurements per batch. Prioritize main overall mAP, reported detector latency and FPS; then author ablations. Never output per-class scores, training hours, training speedup, theoretical recall, literature baselines or repeated copies of one experiment. Keep reasoning to at most 12 words per result.

The complete Faster R-CNN architecture includes the RPN and its detection head; do not label it as the standalone Fast R-CNN baseline. timing_scope=end_to_end means including the detector and any proposal stage; use detector_only_excludes_proposals ONLY when proposal generation is explicitly excluded. For a detector without a separate proposal stage, do not label its own complete pass as excluding proposals.
